newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ANZ's NZ commodity index falls in March.
newsitem.headline: ANZ's NZ commodity index falls in March.

text.p: The average New Zealand dollar price of New Zealand's commodity exports fell 0.2 percent in March following a 1.0 percent rise in February, ANZ Bank said on Monday.
ANZ said its commodity price index showed the corresponding average world price of New Zealand's commodity exports rose 0.8 percent in March following a 1.0 percent rise in February.
The New Zealand dollar index weakened slightly to 99.8 in March from 99.9 in February while the world price index rose to 126 from 125 over the same period.
On an annual basis, the New Zealand dollar index recorded a 6.5 percent fall and the world price index dropped 1.6 percent.

ANZ said the pick up in world beef prices provided some support ot the world commodity price index during March as did a rise in fish and aluminium prices. This was offset by continued weak prices for wool and a gradual easing in lamb prices from their peak in January.
